data.long_meaning: Pra is a name of Lord Vishnu, meaning protector, deity, or light. In Hindu mythology, Vishnu is one of the primary deities, preserver of the universe. Pra is also a shortened form of Prahara, meaning half. The name Pra is associated with creation, knowledge, and the divine. The name Pra carries the meaning “Protector, God, Light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Pra usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, god, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
